records.title: Flyover on T-Junction of Delhi Faridabad-Jaitpur Village
details: The details of the proposed flyover on National Highway-2at its crossing with Mehruali-Badarpur road and Jaitpur road are yet to be worked out.

records.title: Memorandum from Tribal Organisation regarding rehabilitaiton
details: Supplementary by Member regarding rehabiloitation of of tribal displaced in Orissa, it was stated that these things would be taken into consideration after receipt of reports from the field visit.

records.title: Crude pumping station at paradip
details: The Paradip refinery proejct is under review by the Indian Oil Corporation for its revised project cost in the work schedule , in the light of demands supply production of petroleum products in the country

records.title: Losses on passenger and suburban rail operations
details: The information regarding number of passenger trains running from four metros daily and share of money adjusted from cross-subsidisation on these trains is being collected and will be laid on the Table of the House.

records.title: Preservation of Tribal Culture in Orissa
Closing down east coast railway zone
details: However, the entire issue of reorganisation of Railway Zones is under review.

records.title: Cattle population in Orissa
details: The information regarding the strength of loss of Cattle population in Orissa due to three consequitive natural calamities and proposals by the Govt. for increasing the Cattle population in Orissa is being collected and will be laid on the Table of the House.

records.title: Upgrading the quality of foodgrains
details: The requisite information regarding various surplus crops which were available for exports during the last year, and whether Indian foodgrains are graded as substandard in International market, measure taken for producing quality foodgrains is being collected and will be laid on the Table of the House.
